text:
We are looking for you if you:

• Are a B. Sc or M. Sc in any science stream

• Are interested in the clinical research domain

• Love learning and solving interesting problems

• Like working in informal environment, no office politics, and good food

 We are a Pune based software company developing products for clinical research centers. Our product - OpenSpecimen - is used in 65+ biobanks across 16+ countries, including clients like Stanford University, Johns Hopkins University, University of Melbourne, Singapore General Hospital, Cambridge University, etc. Visit for more details.

 Job Profile:

• Learn concepts of clinical research and biobanking

• Learn product and features of OpenSpecimen

• Learn software testing concepts

• Develop test plans and test cases

• Execute test cases

• Write requirement document based on client needs

• Help developers understand requirements

• Write user manuals

 What are we looking for?

• Enthusiastic, keen learner and self-motivated

• Good English - written and oral

• Ability to explore and experiment with new ideas

• Love finding and solving problems
